chunks: From him, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Ḥukaym, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام:
Regarding the menstruating woman: one may drink from her leftover water, but one should not perform wudu (ablution) from it.

key_terms.سُؤْرِهَا: her leftover water or remaining drink

ai.seo_question: Can one drink from the leftover water of a menstruating woman or use it for wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the leftover water of a menstruating woman. It states that drinking from it is permitted, while performing wudu (ablution) with it is not. The narration is relevant to discussions of taharah and ritual purity in fiqh.
